theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate has a validated track record of reducing drawdowns by limiting exposure to eligible themes. Tech Hardware & Semis is eligible, has positive durability (0.66), a trend-classified hurst tag, and no crowding. While rank-IC is zero, staying in eligible trends helps avoid severe shake-outs. An overweight lean is consistent with the discipline of the gate, not a return forecast.
evidence: Headline theme in the narrative rotation
theses.dissent: The gate helps control risk but does not improve absolute returns; momentum rank is noisy and may mean-revert, and the theme could stall if AI capex sentiment shifts against hardware names.

theses.subject: Industrials & Infrastructure
theses.thesis: This eligible theme shows the strongest durability among trend-classified themes (0.75) and no crowding.
